thread:
jordan-cs: Customer ticket #12345 — promo code WELCOMEJUNE copied from marketing email returns 'Promo invalid/expired' at checkout. User says they haven't used it yet. Screenshot attached from customer.
maya-support: Thanks. Can you paste the account_id and the error payload from the client/API? Also customer email
jordan-cs: account_id: acct_98765, email: jordan+trial@example.com
jordan-cs: API response body: {
  "error": "PROMO_EXPIRED",
  "message": "code is expired for this account",
  "promo_id": "p_12345"
}
maya-support: Oof. Can we repro in staging? If it's a code bug we should surface to eng. I've updated ticket and told customer we're investigating and offering interim credit.
devin-eng: I'll take a look. Can you give me account.created_at and the promo window (start/end) from the dashboard? Also any promo targeting rules?
jordan-cs: account.created_at: 2026-03-01T12:34:56Z
jordan-cs: promo p_12345: start_date=2026-02-01T00:00:00Z, end_date=2026-08-31T23:59:59Z, rule: new_accounts_only=true
devin-eng: Those timestamps look good — account was created after promo start so should qualify. Reproduced in staging: same PROMO_EXPIRED.
devin-eng: Repro steps I ran in staging: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer test_xxx' \
  -d '{"code":"WELCOMEJUNE","account_id":"acct_98765"}'
```
response: {"error":"PROMO_EXPIRED","message":"code is expired for this account","promo_id":"p_12345"}
devin-eng: Pulled decision log from promo-service: 
```
INFO promo-check promo_id=p_12345 account=acct_98765 account_created_at=2026-03-01T12:34:56Z promo_start=2026-02-01T00:00:00Z promo_end=2026-08-31T23:59:59Z rule=new_accounts_only=true
DEBUG promo-eval condition: if account_created_at < promo_start then eligible=true else eligible=false
```
devin-eng: Looks like the comparator is inverted — code treats accounts created before start_date as eligible. That explains why newer accounts get rejected (we return PROMO_EXPIRED). I'll fix the comparator (flip < to >) and add unit tests.
henry-billing: If this is a bug we should issue a manual credit to the affected customer now and check for other affected redemptions. I'll approve manual grant for $50.
maya-support: Manual credit $50 issued to acct_98765 and noted on ticket. Let customer know it's applied. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: build #bld-482 started for promo-service (branch/fix/promo-window-compare)
devin-eng: Patch pushed, unit tests added, running CI. Plan: canary to prod, monitor 15m, then full deploy. ETA ~2h.
deploy-bot: build #bld-482 passed, canary deploy started to promo-service-canary
devin-eng: Canary looks clean. Pushing full release now.
deploy-bot: promo-service version v1.14.3 deployed to prod (canary -> primary)
devin-eng: After deploy, re-ran same curl against prod and got success: {"success":true,"credit_amount":50,"promo_id":"p_12345"}
maya-support: Confirmed with customer that redemption succeeded in their checkout flow. Updated ticket with root cause and timeline and closed after customer ack. :tada:
henry-billing: Note: run a quick query to find promos where comparator was inverted to see if any other customers were impacted — I'll coordinate a small backfill job tomorrow.
maya-support: Thanks team. Ticket closed and manual credit reconciled in billing ledger.
